title: Why this strategist is putting money in international stocks

summary: As tech stocks cool and cyclicals gain traction, investors are looking beyond US markets.
summary_zh: 随着科技股降温和周期性股票受到关注，投资者将目光投向美国市场以外的地方。

title: EU threatens temporary measures to stop Meta blocking AI rivals from WhatsApp

summary_zh: 布鲁塞尔，2 月 9 日（路透社）——欧盟竞争监管机构威胁要阻止 Meta Platforms 阻止人工智能竞争对手使用其 WhatsApp 消息服务。

title_zh: 欧盟表示元警告是为了保护消费者

summary_zh: 由于投资者期待本周美国发布的关键经济数据，金价周一上午上涨。

title: Meta criticises EU antitrust move against WhatsApp block on AI rivals

summary: BRUSSELS, Feb 9 (Reuters) - Meta Platforms on Monday criticised EU regulators after they charged the U.S. tech giant with breaching antitrust rules and threaten to halt its block on AI rivals on its
summary_zh: 路透布鲁塞尔 2 月 9 日 - Meta Platforms 周一批评欧盟监管机构，此前欧盟监管机构指控这家美国科技巨头违反反垄断规则，并威胁停止对人工智能竞争对手的封锁。

title: TotalEnergies to provide solar power to Google's Texas data centres
title_zh: TotalEnergies 将为谷歌德克萨斯州数据中心提供太阳能
summary: French oil major TotalEnergies on Monday signed two long-term deals to supply solar ​power to Google's data centres in Texas, as ‌it looks to tap rising electricity demand driven by artificial intelligence.
summary_zh: 法国石油巨头 TotalEnergies 周一签署了两项长期协议，为谷歌位于德克萨斯州的数据中心供应太阳能，该公司希望利用人工智能驱动的不断增长的电力需求。
